cases.symptom: A skipped stage is missing evidence, not a pass
cases.resolution: **A skipped stage is missing evidence, not a pass.** Any gating skip ⇒ `INCONCLUSIVE`.

cases.symptom: Round-trip tests cannot validate a codec
cases.resolution: **Round-trip tests cannot validate a codec.** The first μ-law model inverted the sign bit in both encoder and decoder; encode→decode still matched STL 65536/65536. Only the one-direction comparisons caught it. Keep L1 enc and dec vectors separate.

cases.symptom: A passing suite must be shown to fail
cases.resolution: **A passing suite must be shown to fail.** Before trusting a new check, break the RTL and watch it go red. The first mutation harness reported "0 detected" for every mutant because `head -4` cut the `RESULT` line — a harness bug, not a clean design.

cases.symptom: Reset must be tested against a hostile environment
cases.resolution: **Reset must be tested against a hostile environment.** Releasing reset on a posedge, with `in_valid=0`/`out_ready=1` during reset, let a design with no `out_valid` reset pass all simulation. The TB now drives garbage (`in_valid=1`, `out_ready=0`) during reset and releases on a negedge; formal `A6_reset_empties` covers it independently.

cases.symptom: Watch shift-amount widths
cases.resolution: **Watch shift-amount widths.** `3'd2 + seg` is 3 bits: segments 6/7 wrap to 0/1.

cases.symptom: Formal properties speak about ports only
cases.resolution: **Formal properties speak about ports only.** A hierarchical reference in yosys becomes an undriven wire — a free variable that proves nothing while appearing to run.

cases.symptom:
`equiv_make`/`equiv_induct` is not enough to classify equivalent mutants; the gate
  uses
cases.resolution: **`equiv_make`/`equiv_induct` is not enough** to classify equivalent mutants; the gate uses `miter` + `sat -tempinduct`.

cases.symptom: Datapath registers are not reset (only `out_valid`, REQ-IF-04)
cases.resolution: **Datapath registers are not reset** (only `out_valid`, REQ-IF-04). A data reset value is unobservable, so mutating it only produces un-killable mutants.

cases.symptom: Candidates get isolated build dirs (`RTL_DIR`, `BUILD` for run_all
cases.resolution: **Candidates get isolated build dirs** (`RTL_DIR`, `BUILD` for run_all.sh; `build/gate/<name>`), so parallel mutants never share artifacts.

cases.symptom: ITU blocks plain HTTP clients (curl gets "Request Rejected" / 500)
cases.resolution: ITU blocks plain HTTP clients (curl gets "Request Rejected" / 500). A real browser session works: load the Recommendation page, then `fetch()` the `dologin_pub.asp ... !!PDF-E` URL in-page.

cases.symptom: G
cases.resolution: **G.711 Tables 1/2 are images in the PDF.** Text extraction returns the prose and silently drops the tables. Render the pages and read them; `tests/test_spec_tables.py` is the machine-checkable transcription (rebuilt from columns 2-3 and Notes 2-3 only).

cases.symptom: G
cases.resolution: G.711 §3.6 leaves inputs exactly on a decision value to the implementation. REQ-A-02/U-02 are a DESIGN choice (STL convention), not spec text — do not "fix" them toward the PDF.

cases.symptom: STL's CTest assumes an in-source working dir; run `g711demo` directly (see crosscheck
cases.resolution: STL's CTest assumes an in-source working dir; run `g711demo` directly (see crosscheck.py).

cases.symptom: State the gate's lint contract in the generation prompt
cases.resolution: **State the gate's lint contract in the generation prompt.** The first deepseek run produced candidates that passed all 16 simulation tests and all 8 formal tasks on iteration 1 and were still rejected — by `verilator -Wall` width/unused warnings the prompt never mentioned.

cases.symptom: A fault only one stage can see is a fragile check
cases.resolution: **A fault only one stage can see is a fragile check.** Track `caught_only_by_stage` in the mutation report: it was 4 (synthesize) for async reset until `tb_g711` learned the mid-cycle reset check; it is 0 now.

cases.symptom: A PROVEN verdict is only as strong as the gate that issued it
cases.resolution: **A PROVEN verdict is only as strong as the gate that issued it.** Hermes produced μ-law candidates with `always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)` that passed lint, 4-state sim and unbounded formal — all sample reset at clock edges. REQ-IF-04 (synchronous reset) is now a netlist check in `synthesize` (no `$adff`/`$aldff`/`$dffsr` after `proc`), with a `reset-style` mutation operator proving it. Archived runs from the weaker gate carry a `regate` field.

cases.symptom: A tool error is not a verdict
cases.resolution: **A tool error is not a verdict.** `equiv` reported "differs" when yosys simply could not model an async FF. It now distinguishes `proof did fail` (differs) from other errors (skip).

cases.symptom: Compare data only where it is defined
cases.resolution: **Compare data only where it is defined.** `equiv` masks output data with `out_valid`; a design that differs only in don't-care data (e.g. data register not updated during reset) is equivalent.

cases.symptom: Waveform windows are counted in clock edges, not time
cases.resolution: **Waveform windows are counted in clock edges, not time.** Generated testbenches often omit `timescale; a 10 ns assumption produced an empty trace. `wave_dump` is a separate root (`iverilog -s <tb> -s wave_dump`) so no testbench is ever edited to get a waveform.

cases.symptom: Parse the field you mean
cases.resolution: **Parse the field you mean.** `t=(\d+)` matched the `t=` inside `got=0001`; anchor trailing fields.

cases.symptom: Long generations need a long client timeout
cases.resolution: **Long generations need a long client timeout.** With the strengthened testbench contract deepseek took 13 minutes for one reply; `HERMES_TIMEOUT` (repo `.env`, default 600 s) is the limit, and a timeout is reported as `ERRORED`, not as a bad testbench.

cases.symptom: The generation prompt must never contain the committed implementation (only requirements,
cases.resolution: **The generation prompt must never contain the committed implementation** (only requirements, port contract, conventions); `tests/test_generate.py` enforces it, or PROVEN means copying.
